command:
# G3 checkpoint 2 (#24): the multi-node engine on Standard-8, byte-identity against upstream at the
# pin on the same instance type (Linux aarch64, the canonical platform). One spec, run as a cohort:
# make run GATE=g3 SPEC=runs/g3-std8.json NODES=2|4 (scripts/run-multi.sh). Every member:
#   setup: clone the launch commit, build bin/aws-kraken2; stage opts.k2d, taxo.k2d and the reads,
#          each checked against its sha256 metadata;
#   cases: for each case below, one engine run across all members (AK2_ENGINE_RENDEZVOUS =
#          <cohort prefix>/rendezvous/<case>). Each member loads only its shard of hash.k2d, by
#          ranged GETs of the staged copy (presigned, If-Match its ETag). Rank 0 is the emitter:
#          s3:// outputs are one multipart upload each under <cohort prefix>/out/<case>/, the
#          report is local and pushed.
# Rank 0 then stages the whole hash.k2d, builds upstream at the pin (scripts/oracle-build.sh),
# runs each case through upstream's kraken2 with the same arguments and local outputs, fetches the
# engine's outputs and writes out/identity.tsv (case, file, upstream sha256, engine sha256,
# identical). The run fails if any file differs or is missing. Not a benchmark: no cold rungs.
# Fail fast: the first failed case ends the member (rank 0 then skips upstream).
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=$(echo "$AK2_COHORT_ID" | cut -d- -f3)
RANK=$AK2_ENGINE_RANK; N=$AK2_ENGINE_N
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; B=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}; DATA=${K%/*/*}
NAME=k2_standard_08_GB_20260626; P="$DATA/$NAME"
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
hex64() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; }
[ -n "$AK2_COHORT_ID" ] && [ -n "$RANK" ] && [ -n "$N" ] || fail "not a cohort member (use make run ... NODES=n)"
ak2_say "cohort $AK2_COHORT_ID rank $RANK of $N, commit $SHA"

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git gcc-c++ make zlib-devel perl jq bzip2 gzip tar findutils diffutils > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" -o "$W/go.tgz" || fail "Go download failed"
tar -xzf "$W/go.tgz" -C "$W" || fail "Go unpack failed"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
(cd "$W/repo" && make build) > "$W/make-build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/make-build.out"; fail "make build failed"; }
OURS="$W/repo/bin/aws-kraken2"
TOKEN=$(curl -sf -X PUT -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300" http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token)
IP=$(curl -sf -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)
[ -n "$IP" ] || fail "no private IP from IMDS"
ak2_say "built $(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD); $(go version); private ip $IP; nproc $(nproc); $(free -g | awk '/Mem:/{print "mem_gib " $2}')"

check_obj() {
  local f=$1 key=$2 s want got
  s=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  ak2_req GetObject $(( s < 8388608 ? 1 : (s + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$B"
  want=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$key" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)
  ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
  got=$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  ak2_say "staged $key bytes=$s sha256=$got object-metadata=$want"
  hex64 "$want" && hex64 "$got" && [ "$got" = "$want" ] && [ "$s" -gt 0 ] || fail "$key does not match its sha256 metadata"
}

ak2_phase fetch
DB="$W/db/$NAME"; mkdir -p "$DB"
for f in opts.k2d taxo.k2d SOURCE; do
  ak2_stage "s3://$B/$P/$f" "$DB/$f" || fail "stage of $f failed"
  check_obj "$DB/$f" "$P/$f"
done
RD="$W/reads"; mkdir -p "$RD"
for r in SRR062634 ERR478965 SRR28305653; do
  for f in "${r}_200000_1.fq" "${r}_200000_2.fq" "${r}_200000_1.fq.gz" "${r}_200000_2.fq.gz"; do
    ak2_stage "s3://$B/$DATA/reads/$f" "$RD/$f" || fail "stage of reads/$f failed"
    check_obj "$RD/$f" "$DATA/reads/$f"
  done
done
aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$P/hash.k2d" > "$W/head-hash.json" || fail "head-object hash.k2d failed"
ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
ETAG=$(jq -r '.ETag | gsub("\"";"")' "$W/head-hash.json"); SIZE=$(jq -r .ContentLength "$W/head-hash.json")
HASH_SHA=$(jq -r .Metadata.sha256 "$W/head-hash.json")
URL=$(aws s3 presign "s3://$B/$P/hash.k2d" --expires-in 14400) || fail "presign failed"
ak2_say "hash.k2d etag=$ETAG size=$SIZE sha256-metadata=$HASH_SHA"

# The cases: name|arguments|inputs (relative to $RD). Outputs: o = --output to s3, c = classified
# and unclassified to s3 (paired: #), r = --report (local, pushed). Same order on every member.
S1="SRR062634_200000"; S2="ERR478965_200000"; S3="SRR28305653_200000"
CASES=(
  "pe-gz-S1|--paired|$S1 gz|ocr"
  "se-fq-S2|--report-zero-counts|$S2 fq1|or"
  "pe-fq-S3-conf|--paired --confidence 0.1 --use-names|$S3 fq|ocr"
  "pe-gz-S2-quick-mpa|--paired --quick --minimum-hit-groups 1 --use-mpa-style|$S2 gz|or"
  "se-multi-q20|--minimum-base-quality 20|$S1 fq1,$S2 fq1|ocr"
)
inputs() {  # "STEM KIND[,STEM KIND]" -> paths; KIND gz|fq (paired) or fq1 (mate 1 only)
  local spec=$1 one stem kind
  IFS=',' read -r -a parts <<< "$spec"
  for one in "${parts[@]}"; do
    stem=${one% *}; kind=${one#* }
    case $kind in
      gz) echo "$RD/${stem}_1.fq.gz"; echo "$RD/${stem}_2.fq.gz" ;;
      fq) echo "$RD/${stem}_1.fq"; echo "$RD/${stem}_2.fq" ;;
      fq1) echo "$RD/${stem}_1.fq" ;;
    esac
  done
}
outargs() {  # case outs paired base -> output arguments (base: s3 prefix or local dir)
  local name=$1 outs=$2 paired=$3 base=$4 rep=$5
  [[ $outs == *o* ]] && echo "--output" && echo "$base/output.txt"
  if [[ $outs == *c* ]]; then
    if [ "$paired" = yes ]; then echo "--classified-out"; echo "$base/cls#.fq"; echo "--unclassified-out"; echo "$base/uncls#.fq"
    else echo "--classified-out"; echo "$base/cls.fq"; echo "--unclassified-out"; echo "$base/uncls.fq"; fi
  fi
  [[ $outs != *o* ]] && echo "--output" && echo "-"
  [[ $outs == *r* ]] && echo "--report" && echo "$rep"
}
TH=$(nproc)
FAILED=0
declare -A ERC
for c in "${CASES[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r name args ins outs <<< "$c"
  paired=no; [[ " $args " == *" --paired "* ]] && paired=yes
  mapfile -t IN < <(inputs "$ins")
  mapfile -t OUTA < <(outargs "$name" "$outs" "$paired" "$AK2_COHORT_PREFIX/out/$name" "$W/eng-$name.report")
  ak2_phase "case-$name"
  ak2_say "case $name: $OURS --db $DB --threads $TH $args ${OUTA[*]} ${IN[*]}"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  AK2_ENGINE_RENDEZVOUS="$AK2_ENGINE_RENDEZVOUS/$name" AK2_ENGINE_LISTEN="$IP" AK2_ENGINE_TIMEOUT=10m \
    AK2_ENGINE_HASH_URL="$URL" AK2_ENGINE_HASH_ETAG="$ETAG" AK2_ENGINE_HASH_SIZE="$SIZE" AK2_TIMINGS=1 \
    "$OURS" --db "$DB" --threads "$TH" $args "${OUTA[@]}" "${IN[@]}" > "$W/eng-$name.stdout" 2> "$W/eng-$name.stderr"
  rc=$?
  ERC[$name]=$rc
  ak2_say "case $name rank $RANK exit $rc"
  grep -E '^ak2-(timing|engine)' "$W/eng-$name.stderr" | sed "s/^/[$name] /"
  grep -vE '^ak2-(timing|engine)' "$W/eng-$name.stderr" | tail -5 | sed "s/^/[$name stderr] /"
  ak2_push "$W/eng-$name.stderr" "rank$RANK/eng-$name.stderr"
  [ "$RANK" = 0 ] && [ -f "$W/eng-$name.report" ] && ak2_push "$W/eng-$name.report" "eng-$name.report"
  # Fail fast: a failed case ends this member (an engine failure fails every member's run of the
  # case, so all of them stop here; make run then terminates any member still up).
  [ "$rc" = 0 ] || { FAILED=$((FAILED + 1)); ak2_say "case $name FAILED on rank $RANK: stopping"; break; }
done
ak2_req RendezvousS3 "$(grep -h 'ak2-engine.rendezvous' "$W"/eng-*.stderr | awk -F'\t' '{s+=$4} END{print s+0}')" "$B"
if [ "$RANK" != 0 ] || [ "$FAILED" != 0 ]; then
  ak2_say "rank $RANK done: $FAILED failed case(s)"
  [ "$FAILED" = 0 ] || exit 1
  exit 0
fi

# Rank 0: upstream at the pin, the same cases, local outputs; then compare.
ak2_phase upstream-fetch
ak2_stage "s3://$B/$P/hash.k2d" "$DB/hash.k2d" || fail "stage of hash.k2d failed"
check_obj "$DB/hash.k2d" "$P/hash.k2d"
ak2_phase upstream-build
K2DIR=$(cd "$W/repo" && scripts/oracle-build.sh 2> "$W/oracle-build.err") || { tail -30 "$W/oracle-build.err"; fail "oracle-build failed"; }
UP="$K2DIR/kraken2"
[ -x "$UP" ] || fail "no upstream kraken2 at $UP"
ak2_say "upstream: $UP ($(cat "$K2DIR/BUILD" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-200))"
T="$W/identity.tsv"
printf 'case\tfile\tupstream_sha256\tengine_sha256\tidentical\tupstream_exit\tengine_exit\n' > "$T"
for c in "${CASES[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r name args ins outs <<< "$c"
  paired=no; [[ " $args " == *" --paired "* ]] && paired=yes
  mapfile -t IN < <(inputs "$ins")
  U="$W/up/$name"; E="$W/eng/$name"; mkdir -p "$U" "$E"
  mapfile -t OUTA < <(outargs "$name" "$outs" "$paired" "$U" "$U/report")
  ak2_phase "upstream-$name"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  "$UP" --db "$DB" --threads "$TH" $args "${OUTA[@]}" "${IN[@]}" > "$U/stdout" 2> "$U/stderr"
  urc=$?
  erc=${ERC[$name]:-none}
  aws s3 cp --only-show-errors --recursive "$AK2_COHORT_PREFIX/out/$name/" "$E/" || ak2_say "no engine objects for $name"
  ak2_req ListObjectsV2 1 "$B"
  cp "$W/eng-$name.report" "$E/report" 2>/dev/null
  for f in $(cd "$U" && ls | grep -vE '^(stdout|stderr)$'); do
    us=$(sha256sum "$U/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    es=absent; [ -f "$E/$f" ] && es=$(sha256sum "$E/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    same=no; [ "$us" = "$es" ] && [ "$urc" = "$erc" ] && same=yes
    [ "$same" = yes ] || FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$f" "$us" "$es" "$same" "$urc" "$erc" >> "$T"
    ak2_say "identity $name $f: upstream $us engine $es identical=$same"
  done
done
ak2_push "$T" identity.tsv
ak2_say "rank 0 done: $FAILED failure(s) (cases failed on rank 0 or files differing)"
[ "$FAILED" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
